human_tolerance.notes: Authored judgement: a bush and garden-edge songbird of dry savanna; no open source checked for its tolerance of people.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Authored judgement for the southern-hemisphere summer in Namibia; the record's nesting behaviour is restricted to these months.

vocalizations.description: Series of loud fluty notes, usually given only by the male.
Authored judgement: a short alarm note given when disturbed; no open recording or description was checked.

taxonomy.note: GBIF usage 2486146 matched at species rank, status ACCEPTED, family Pycnonotidae (checked 2026-10-31). Wikipedia lists 'Turdus nigricans' as a synonym.

external.note: iNaturalist 14625 (Wikidata P3151, species rank, active) and NCBI 374634 (Wikidata P685). Subspecies taxa 698699 and 698700 are not used.

common_names.note: Common name 'African red-eyed bulbul' as given in the Wikipedia article title and infobox.

conservation.note: Wikidata P141 (IUCN status) item Q211005 is 'least concern'; Wikipedia gives LC citing BirdLife International 2018 (secondary, not openly licensed upstream).

range.note: Native status from Wikipedia: nominate subspecies found in south-western Angola, Namibia, Botswana and western South Africa. GBIF species distributions list only the continent 'Africa'; NA occurrence counts (GBIF 30,668; iNaturalist place 7140 = Namibia, 909) show presence but are not, by themselves, native-status evidence.

traits.body_plan.note: Class/order-level: Aves, Passeriformes (GBIF backbone classification). Authored conventions for body plan, limb count, thermoregulation, skin, flight, respiration and metamorphosis.

traits.limb_count.note: Two limbs; authored convention for a passerine.

traits.flight.note: Powered flight; Wikipedia gives no flight-mode detail, authored convention for passerines.

traits.perching.note: Passerine perching; authored judgement for a songbird that the behaviour program perches.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Hop and fly are the modes the behaviour program uses; the species is not described as hopping in Wikipedia. Authored judgement.

traits.mass_kg.note: Derived: midpoint of Wikipedia's 30-48 g adult weight range (0.039 kg). The Dryad covariate mass for this taxon is 30.8 g (dryad-scholer-2020); it sits at the low end, so it was not used as the typical value.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: Wikipedia 'weighs 30-48 grams' (secondary; Wikipedia cites HBW, which is not openly licensed).

traits.length_m.note: Derived: midpoint of Wikipedia's 19-21 cm length (0.20 m). Total length, not wingspan.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Derived proxy, not a measured typical lifespan. Input: Dryad row X=135 (Pycnonotus nigricans, Black-fronted Bulbul, South Africa lat -28.6 long 23.6, resident, dead-recovery, survival 0.626, SE 0.12; Collingham et al. 2014 as cited in the dataset). Method: expected life after breeding age ex = Ba + (-1/ln phi), with Ba = 1 y (authored assumption; no source for this species' age at first breeding was checked) and phi = 0.626, giving 1 + 2.13 = 3.1 y. The SE of 0.12 on phi spans roughly 0.39-0.86, which implies about 2 to 8 y. Derived from a single population in the southern part of the range, so applying it to the Namibian population is an extrapolation.

traits.diet.note: Authored allocation. Wikipedia lists fruit (including Ficus), flowers, nectar and insects, without proportions. Fruit 0.6, invertebrate 0.3, nectar 0.1 is judgement, summing to 1.

traits.nest_type.note: Cup nest: authored judgement for a bulbul; no open source checked.

traits.size_class.note: Tiny by the validator size bin (mass below 0.05 kg) applied to the derived mass 0.039 kg from Wikipedia 30-48 g; the bin is the repository convention, not a biological category.

traits.social.note: Authored judgement: Group structure from a Wikipedia photo caption of communal bathing with one or two birds keeping watch (not quantified). Group size 2-6 is judgement with no source checked.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Diurnal: authored; the species is active by day and its song is diurnal in the sources checked.

traits.defense.note: Flee: authored judgement for a small perching songbird.

traits.wariness.note: Authored judgement (0.3) with no source; rate not measured.

habitat.note: Habitat types (dry savanna, subtropical or tropical dry shrubland, riverine scrub) from Wikipedia. Resource tags, weights, shelter tag and human-tolerance values are authored judgement.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Authored judgement: garden-edge use and adapter status; no open source checked for tolerance of people.

seasonal.note: Resident: Dryad row migration column = 'resident' for Pycnonotus nigricans. The breeding window (1 Nov to 28 Feb, Namibia) is an authored judgement: regional breeding-season summaries exist but were not openly licensed, so they are not cited as provenance.

vocalizations.note: Song: 'a series of loud fluty notes, usually given only by the male' (Wikipedia). Alarm call and time windows are authored judgement.

look.note: Authored colour and proportion judgement for the rendered model (black-fronted head, olive back, red eye from the common name); not measured from images.

behavior.note: Authored behaviour: species-local program bt-bulbul-nigricans-v1. Derived from the shared bt-perching-songbird-v1 structure. See the program description for why the shared program was not used as-is.
